placements.why: The document's content is an engineering infrastructure decision — a database migration for an analytics pipeline — which names the organizational category of architecture-level choices. No existing strata exists, so this mints the category the content calls for.
placements.title: Engineering infrastructure as a decision domain
placements.frame: What infrastructure choices are being made, and what technical grounds justify them?

placements.title: Infrastructure migration performed as settled
placements.frame: How are infrastructure migration decisions performed as settled rather than proposed?
placements.why: src-1 and src-2 perform the PostgreSQL→QuantumDB switch as a done deal ('we're switching'), and src-4 compresses it into arrow notation under a decisions heading. src-6 adds a fixed Q3 2026 timeline commitment. The theme — migrations asserted as decided, not argued — is true beyond these specific words and would accumulate future migration decisions.

placements.title: Quantified performance and cost as decision basis
placements.frame: How are infrastructure decisions justified through quantified performance and cost metrics?
placements.why: src-1 and src-2 marshal '10x query performance' and 'lower licensing cost' as evidence-based justification for the switch; src-5 reiterates the quantified performance gain as a summary claim. The theme — cost-benefit quantification as the reasoning pattern for infrastructure choices — extends beyond this single decision.
